messages:
emily: Quick thread: saved queries cost preview is misleading when routing policy applies percent-based regional routing. E.g. I saved a per-route view pinned to `redwood/xl-2025` but my org has 30% traffic routed to eu-west which only has `redwood/xl-quant` available. Cost preview shows the pinned model price only.

rajesh: Oh nice catch. We currently compute cost_preview purely from the `pinned_model` field in saved query proto, ignoring routing hints.

alyssa: UX ask: can we surface a "multi-model cost breakdown" in the preview when routing policies are non-trivial? Maybe show a small stacked bar: pinned vs fallbacks and percentage. No need for heavy charting, just inline numbers.

emily: That would be ideal. Also we need to be clear whether the preview is an estimate based on config vs actual recent served distribution. Two modes: "config simulation" vs "observed last 7d".

rajesh: Backend idea: extend the savedview evaluation endpoint /v1/savedviews/{id}/preview to accept query param `mode={config|observed}`. In config mode simulate routing policy using exact weights; in observed mode use last-7d served_model rollup.

kevin: Question: for config simulation we need cost profiles for quantized variants (xl vs xl-quant). Do we have those canonical price entries accessible to sim service? We have price catalog per model-version in pricing service already.

alyssa: Microcopy: preview header should say "Estimated token cost — based on routing configuration (simulated)" or "Estimated token cost — based on observed serving distribution (last 7 days)". Add a small tooltip linking to docs on how routing rolls up to cost.

console-bot: savedview-preview-service v0.9.3 rolled out to staging at 1751234600 :white_check_mark:

rajesh: Implementation plan: 1) add `mode` param and multi-model breakdown in preview response (optional field `breakdown: [{model, pct, cost}]`), 2) frontend renders stacked numbers and toggles mode, 3) add event telemetry `savedview_preview_mode_selected` for telemetry experiments.

emily: Tradeoffs: observed mode requires rollup accuracy; if the saved view filters to narrow group, rollup sampling might be noisy. We'll show an accuracy badge when sample size < 500 requests.

kevin: Also we should ensure preview results are cached per-savedview+mode for a short TTL to avoid heavy sim calls.

alyssa: I'll sketch the UI in Figma and include the microcopy. rajesh can you take ownership of the API change?

rajesh: Yup, will open a small PR with interface + docs. ETA EOD Friday for initial prototype.
